preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input consists of a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10) followed by n integers a_i (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 1000) representing the number of balloons in each packet.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout.split()[0] == 'k' and k := int(stdout.split()[0]) and 1 <= k <= n - 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()[1:]) and set(stdout.split()[1:]) == set(stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no valid distribution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a line starting with k (1 ≤ k ≤ n-1), followed by k distinct packet indices (1 ≤ index ≤ n) assigned to Grigory.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and (sum(a_i for i in range(1, n + 1) if i in set(stdout.split()[1:])) != sum(a_i for i in range(1, n + 1) if i not in set(stdout.split()[1:])))
postconditions.description: The total number of balloons assigned to Grigory is not equal to the total number assigned to Andrew.
Both Grigory and Andrew receive at least one packet (1 ≤ k ≤ n-1).
